content:
It is difficult to talk and
making it easier does not
make it any easier to
talk in a hoop or through an un-
remembered or lit-up eitherware.
There are incorrect capital
soothsayers and they swerve into
luminiferous layers and
they tell you it can't and won't work
and they long for large fruit and
they are as local as can be.

title: Eitherware advancing

content:
It's morning and I'm not moving.
A fainting goat goes in both ways
or seizes up when startled, even as
a global model too is a great pet. To
date, all yearlings or global models
which come up seize up when startled.
The white boom of their coming to life
(as less or more a beloved fainting goat
in a set of fainting goats) is too much :
is a missense : can't help it : goes to chevon.
On a garden swing or in a braced programme or
in a meadow of summaries for a different present,
you can pick up a fainted model of the world,
and its legs will not move, in a terrible way.

content:
It is time in a peace of time
in this corner anyway and
I have fantasies of the claim–
handling library at last. Well,
it is in time that you wake up,
and a leap indicator bit
is set by hand or is expected
to be. And because we have met,
in adjunct slow-vision mischief,
we have now a roundtrip delay
and we have now assumed a mode
of symmetric togetherness,
a mode of being symmetric
togetherness, a symmetric
driftless togetherness and both
a suitcase and a thermos at
our hand while we try to work
out how to set our watches

title: Second leaping

content:
You set this in motion. This
was unfolding before your eyes. You
were devastated. You
were blocks from the White House. You
were recalling your reaction. You
quieted. This is for everyone. You
were virtually sorrowful. You
were actual. Am I still there? Your
mind and body were in a different state. You
went on to recount at a staccato pace. You
went on in elliptical passages. You
had pain in watching your creation so distorted. You
are now embarking on a determined third act. You
have for some time been working on a new platform. Yours
was an apparent solid thing with democratic roots but it
has been taken. The futures were fast approaching. Human rights
were being protected in 2009. Résumés
were functioning like the human brain. Political views
are more valuable. Deoxyribo nucleic acid
is enquiring within upon everything. Am I still there? Born
in the early 1960s and growing up in London, what
has been produced
is a large-scale emergent phenomenon which
is anti-human.

could, but it doesn’t.
Even if it could.

content: (The sentiment of the world is that it and its parts are always waterlessly hunting. What happens when we imagine the Internet is that it is the working of the waterless hunting of the world. But we think of actually imagining sentimentally as if it works like something else, some smaller part of the world that goes against the grain of the sentiment of the world as if it is the catching and burnishing of the corner parts of the world which attract soil and become dirty. Imagining is imagined to be clean and cornerless, like the line between one and the other when we think of a thing working like something else. We say that termites are eusocial in that they work together, and we imagine that the clean and waterless hunting of the Internet might also actually be a form of working together, but I don’t want the analogy of the way termites work to come across and wash away this always there sentiment of the way the world is always waterlessly hunting and replace it with the sense of the time and place of the world where clean water meets and permeates the corner parts of the world, which we say is called a petrichor, and I imagine sadly how a petrichor might have a kind of lifespan, in that it is there at first with a time and place but eventually it runs out.)
title: Net fruiting
